items.summary: Upstream #18 uses __builtin_amdgcn_wave_barrier() (scheduling barrier) as the __syncwarp() stand-in in migemm_neighmap_pp.cu:281-288, where lanes consume LDS written by other lanes. Correct on CDNA lockstep and wave64-correct indexing, but __threadfence_block() is the stronger form. Candidate one-line upstream PR; a person rules whether to pursue.

decided.note: No observed failure and no validated FlexGEMM port to test against; revisit if FlexGEMM is adopted as a TRELLIS.2 dependency and a wave32 card shows a real fault.

items.summary: Upstream bug on every platform, not ROCm-specific: indice_weighed_sum_bwd_input_kernel scatters with tl.atomic_add into grad_input allocated by the wrapper, but its autotuner has no reset_to_zero, so on an autotune cache miss every benchmarked config accumulates into the returned buffer and the first backward call for a new (LOGN, M, C, V) key returns wrong gradients (upstream 6dd94a8 on MI300X: first/second-call max ratio ~24000 at M=4096 C=8 V=8 N=1024; later calls are correct). Fix is reset_to_zero=['grad_input'] on the decorator. A person rules: separate unprefixed commit in this port, an upstream issue/PR, or leave.
